instruction.text: Look at the example sentence below and fill in the following gaps about the past perfect.

atoms.a: She had fallen asleep before her dog joined her.
atoms.b: The past perfect tense shows that something took place prior to another action or event in the ((++past present future)).
To form the past perfect tense, you need the helping verb ((++had has)) and the past participle form of a verb.

instruction.text: Which sentence is in the past perfect tense?
Select the past perfect form in the sentence.

atoms.sound: They had forgotten about their chores until their parents came back from holiday.

instruction.text: Select the past perfect form in the sentence.

atoms.sound: He was prepared for the journey to come since he had learnt from his past mistakes.

instruction.text: Select the past perfect form in the sentence.

atoms.sound: We had hurried to the train station, since we were late.

instruction.text: Match the verbs with their past participle forms.
Fill in the gaps with the past perfect form of the verb.

hint.text:
Remember: to form the past perfect tense you need the helping verb had + the past participle form of a verb.

For example:
She had done this before.
hint.sound: Remember: to form the past perfect tense you need the helping verb, had, and the past participle form of a verb. For example: She had done this before.

atoms.b: She couldn’t remember the last time she ((had_eaten)) ice cream.
Frederick ((had_gone)) to the DIY shop before Alicia had the chance to ask him to get a new saw.
To my parents’ dismay, when I was a child, I ((had_dug)) all types of holes in the garden.
After she ((had_spoken)) to her boss about no longer working weekends, she felt relieved.
Did you notice that all the birds ((had_flown)) south last year?
